title: CSJMU UP Government Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement Amount Matrix

sc_st_students.details: SC/ST category students receive up to Rs. 1,17,000 per year under UP Government Fee Reimbursement Scheme regardless of hostel or day scholar status.

general_obc_students.details: General and OBC category students receive Rs. 64,500 with hostel accommodation and Rs. 57,000 for day scholars under UP Government Fee Reimbursement.

title: Official Checklist of Required Documents for UP Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement Application
guidelines: Students applying for UP Government Scholarship or Fee Reimbursement must submit all 16 listed documents along with the final application printout to the scholarship cell.

title: Swami Vivekananda Youth Empowerment Scheme (UP Free Tablet / Smartphone Scheme)
eligibility: Eligible undergraduate and postgraduate students enrolled in CSJMU & UIET engineering, science, and vocational programs.
benefits: Free digital devices (tablets or smartphones) distributed by the UP Government to empower youth with modern educational tools and digital access.
